methods.formula: Value = (assets in place + C − net debt) ÷ shares;  C = S·N(d₁) − K·e^(−rT)·N(d₂), d₁ = [ln(S ÷ K) + (r + σ²/2)T] ÷ σ√T, d₂ = d₁ − σ√T
steps: S = the expansion in year 5: the revenue it adds $40.32B (to $85.89B) × margin 8.0% × (1 − tax), as a growing perpetuity, discounted = $30.00B
K = capital to build it: $40.32B ÷ sales-to-capital 1.50 = $26.88B
σ = 29% (its stock, a year of daily closes), T = 5 years, r = 4.91% → C = $11.90B
assets in place = NOPAT −$34.29M ÷ WACC = $0; value = ($0 + $11.90B − net debt $485.2M) ÷ 54,400,000 = $209.87

methods.formula: Value = D₀ × [(1 + g_L) + H × (g_S − g_L)] ÷ (kₑ − g_L);  growth falls in a straight line from g_S to g_L over 2H years
